evidence: Current Rust source reads and edits only; no build, syntax check, tests, shader compilation, GPU calls, project/game execution or process inspection

submission.callerLease: Targets.from_owned requires an actual current native world color/depth owner, per-plane states and a thread-safe retained owner token; identifiers and COM pointers do not establish that lease
joins: same device for targets, uploaded geometry, constants and pipelines
submission.recording: Construct the Java order once, create private RTV/DSV heaps and direct allocator/list, set matching viewport/scissor, record ordered geometry, restore incoming states and close before queue execution
submission.stateTransitions: Color plane 0 -> RENDER_TARGET; depth plane 0 -> DEPTH_WRITE; stencil plane 1 -> DEPTH_READ with READ_ONLY_STENCIL DSV; restore every changed plane in reverse order
submission.shape: Single-mip, single-array Texture2D surfaces matching the packet; typed or compatible typeless color/depth resource formats
submission.stencilContents: Stencil testing/writes remain disabled by the material pipelines; separate incoming stencil state is retained/restored
submission.preparationFailure: Drop an unsubmitted private list; no GPU target modifications have executed
submission.completion: Return only a private-fence-retired receipt for the caller-supplied scope; not shader/pixel or independently observed native-lease verification

sharedRetirement.preSubmitChecks: Queue, allocator and list must belong to the supplied direct device
sharedRetirement.ownershipTransfer: All owners enter a ticket before ExecuteCommandLists
sharedRetirement.completion: Private fence is signaled once and must complete value 1; UINT64_MAX is not success
sharedRetirement.droppedPendingTicket: Move into its bounded abandoned slot and retain its permit/owners
sharedRetirement.signalFailure: Keep submitted owners even without a usable completion signal; release only on proven retirement or reported device removal
sharedRetirement.polling: Nonblocking; no helper threads, sleeps or timeout release
sharedRetirement.destruction: Retired payload/native owner destructors run outside slot locks to permit adapter reentry
sharedRetirement.runtimeCleanup: DX12 before-frame callback collects retired upload/draw payloads even when no new draw is requested

observerIsolation.guard: depth_tracker.private_commands preserves/restores the previous TLS marker across nested private/readback scopes
observerIsolation.coverage: Upload/draw recording and shared submission exclude Arctic-owned descriptors, lists, barriers and submissions from native-world evidence
observerIsolation.readback: Existing readback scopes use the same nesting-safe guard
